natural: Skilful hands bringing back spring

meaning.en: (Of a doctor) to work miracles; to cure the seriously ill.
meaning.zh: 指医生医术高明，能把垂危的病人治好。

examples.zh: 多亏这位医生妙手回春，父亲才转危为安。
examples.en: Thanks to the doctor's miraculous skill, my father pulled through.

examples.zh: 病人家属送来一面写着"妙手回春"的锦旗。
examples.en: The patient's family presented a banner reading "Miracle Worker".

usage.en: Predicate. Common on thank-you banners to doctors.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于赠医生的锦旗。

natural: Changes beyond prediction

meaning.en: Unpredictable; constantly changing.
meaning.zh: 变化很多，不能预测。

examples.zh: 山区的天气变幻莫测。
examples.en: Mountain weather is unpredictable.

examples.zh: 股市变幻莫测，投资要谨慎。
examples.en: The stock market is volatile — invest carefully.

natural: Firmly holding the ticket to victory

meaning.en: Certain of victory.
meaning.zh: 比喻有充分把握取得胜利。

examples.zh: 他实力最强，在这次比赛中稳操胜券。
examples.en: He's the strongest, so victory is in the bag.

examples.zh: 不要以为稳操胜券就放松。
examples.en: Don't relax thinking it's a foregone conclusion.

antonyms: 阴沟里翻船——没想到的事

natural: Having a beginning and an end

meaning.en: To see something through from start to finish.
meaning.zh: 有开头也有结尾。指做事能坚持到底。

examples.zh: 做事要有始有终。
examples.en: Always finish what you start.

examples.zh: 她有始有终，把项目做完才离职。
examples.en: She saw the project through before leaving.

natural: The gleam of pearls and the aura of jewels

meaning.en: Dripping with jewellery; glittering and lavish.
meaning.zh: 形容妇女服饰华丽，闪耀着珍宝的光彩。

examples.zh: 宴会上的贵妇们个个珠光宝气。
examples.en: The ladies at the banquet were all dripping with jewels.

examples.zh: 她打扮得珠光宝气，引人注目。
examples.en: Bejewelled from head to toe, she turned heads.

usage.en: Predicate or complement. Can hint at ostentation.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，有时含炫富之意。

pinyin: cǐ dì wú yín sān bǎi liǎng
literal: this · place · no · silver · three · hundred · taels
natural: No 300 taels of silver buried here

meaning.en: A clumsy denial that gives the game away.
meaning.zh: 比喻想要隐瞒、掩饰，结果反而暴露。

equivalents: the lady doth protest too much

examples.zh: 他一直强调自己没偷看，这不是此地无银三百两吗？
examples.en: He keeps insisting he didn't peek — the lady doth protest too much.

examples.zh: 公司急着否认，反倒有此地无银三百两之嫌。
examples.en: The company's hasty denial looked like a dead giveaway.

story.en: A man buried 300 taels of silver and put up a sign: "No 300 taels of silver here". His neighbour Wang Er stole it and put up his own sign: "Neighbour Wang Er did not steal it."
story.zh: 有人把三百两银子埋在地下，上面写"此地无银三百两"。邻居王二偷走后，也写上"隔壁王二不曾偷"。

usage.en: Predicate or object. Often with 隔壁王二不曾偷.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常与"隔壁王二不曾偷"连用。

natural: Sharing life and death together

meaning.en: To share life and death; to stand together through everything.
meaning.zh: 同生共死，形容情谊极深。

examples.zh: 他们是生死与共的战友。
examples.en: They're comrades who'd stand together to the death.

examples.zh: 夫妻俩生死与共，相守一生。
examples.en: The couple stood together through everything their whole lives.

natural: Full of sorrow and easily moved

meaning.en: Sentimental and melancholy; easily moved.
meaning.zh: 经常发愁和伤感。形容感情脆弱。

equivalents: wear one's heart on one's sleeve

examples.zh: 她多愁善感，看电影常常哭。
examples.en: She's very sentimental and often cries at films.

examples.zh: 林黛玉是一个多愁善感的人物。
examples.en: Lin Daiyu is a melancholy, sensitive character.

natural: Great rebellion against the right way

meaning.en: Treasonous; outrageously defying convention.
meaning.zh: 封建统治者对反抗封建统治、背叛封建礼教的人所加的重大罪名。现也指违背常理。

examples.zh: 在古代，反对皇帝被视为大逆不道。
examples.en: In ancient times, opposing the emperor was considered treason.

examples.zh: 在他父亲眼里，女儿不结婚简直大逆不道。
examples.en: In her father's eyes, his daughter not marrying was practically heresy.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Now often humorous or ironic.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，现常含讽刺。

natural: Silent as a cicada in the cold

meaning.en: Silent out of fear; keeping quiet.
meaning.zh: 像深秋的蝉那样一声不吭。比喻因害怕而不敢说话。

examples.zh: 在独裁者面前，大臣们噤若寒蝉。
examples.en: Before the dictator, the ministers were cowed into silence.

examples.zh: 老板发火时，员工们噤若寒蝉。
examples.en: When the boss lost his temper, the staff kept their mouths shut.

story.en: Du Mi criticised an official who "knew good men but didn't recommend them, heard of wrongs but said nothing... making himself like a cicada in the cold" (自同寒蝉).
story.zh: 杜密批评刘胜："知善不荐，闻恶无言，隐情惜己，自同寒蝉。"

natural: Yes with the mouth, no in the heart

meaning.en: To say one thing and mean another; two-faced.
meaning.zh: 嘴里说得很好，心里想的却是另一套。指心口不一致。

equivalents: say one thing and mean another

examples.zh: 他嘴上说支持，其实口是心非。
examples.en: He says he supports it, but he doesn't mean it.

examples.zh: 别相信那种口是心非的人。
examples.en: Don't trust two-faced people like that.

natural: Not off by a fraction

meaning.en: Exactly right; not off by a hair.
meaning.zh: 一分一毫都不差。形容非常准确。

examples.zh: 他算的账分毫不差。
examples.en: His accounts are spot on.

examples.zh: 这个零件尺寸分毫不差。
examples.en: The part's dimensions are exact.

natural: What one does, one receives

meaning.en: To suffer from one's own actions; serves one right.
meaning.zh: 自己做了错事，自己承受不好的后果。

equivalents: you made your bed, now lie in it

examples.zh: 他不听劝告，结果受伤了，真是自作自受。
examples.en: He ignored the advice and got hurt — serves him right.

examples.zh: 熬夜打游戏导致考试不及格，自作自受。
examples.en: Gaming all night and failing the exam — he asked for it.

natural: Free and at ease

meaning.en: Free and unfettered; carefree.
meaning.zh: 无拘无束，自由自在。

equivalents: without a care in the world

examples.zh: 退休后他过着逍遥自在的日子。
examples.en: Since retiring he's been free as a bird.

examples.zh: 他一个人逍遥自在，不想结婚。
examples.en: He's happily footloose and fancy-free and doesn't want to marry.

natural: Marking the boat to find the sword

meaning.en: To be rigid and fail to adapt to changing circumstances.
meaning.zh: 比喻拘泥固执，不知道根据实际情况变化而灵活处理。

equivalents: close the stable door after the horse has bolted

examples.zh: 用十年前的方法解决今天的问题，无异于刻舟求剑。
examples.en: Using methods from ten years ago for today's problems is failing to adapt.

examples.zh: 市场变了，不能刻舟求剑。
examples.en: The market has changed — we can't be stuck in the past.

story.en: A man from Chu dropped his sword overboard while crossing a river. He carved a mark on the boat where it fell; when the boat stopped, he jumped in at the mark to look for it.
story.zh: 楚人渡江，剑掉入水中，他在船上刻记号，船停后从记号处下水找剑。

natural: The lotus root breaks but its threads still join

meaning.en: Lingering ties after a breakup.
meaning.zh: 藕已折断，但还有许多丝连接着。比喻没有彻底断绝关系，多指男女之间情意未断。

examples.zh: 他们分手了，可还藕断丝连。
examples.en: They've broken up but still have lingering feelings.

examples.zh: 他和原公司还藕断丝连。
examples.en: He still has ties with his old company.

story.en: Meng Jiao's poem in the voice of a divorced wife: "My heart is like the threads in a lotus root — though broken, they still hold together" (妾心藕中丝，虽断犹牵连).
story.zh: 孟郊《去妇》："妾心藕中丝，虽断犹牵连。"

natural: Calm and just as usual

meaning.en: Perfectly calm and composed.
meaning.zh: 形容在紧急情况下沉着镇定，不慌不乱。

examples.zh: 面对记者的质问，他泰然自若。
examples.en: Faced with reporters' questions, he was cool as a cucumber.

examples.zh: 飞机遇到气流，乘务员泰然自若地安抚乘客。
examples.en: When the plane hit turbulence, the cabin crew calmly reassured passengers.

natural: Wealth flowing in from every source

meaning.en: May wealth flow in (a business greeting).
meaning.zh: 钱财来源广泛，财富不断涌进。多用作祝福语。

examples.zh: 祝您新年生意兴隆，财源广进！
examples.en: Wishing you a prosperous New Year with business booming!

examples.zh: 店门口贴着"财源广进"的春联。
examples.en: A couplet reading "may wealth flow in" hangs at the shop door.

usage.en: Mostly a New Year or business greeting.

natural: Dealing with it calmly

meaning.en: To take something calmly in one's stride.
meaning.zh: 形容对待事情沉着镇定，不当一回事。

examples.zh: 面对批评，他泰然处之。
examples.en: He took the criticism in his stride.

examples.zh: 遇到挫折要泰然处之。
examples.en: Take setbacks calmly.

antonyms: 十五个吊桶打水——七上八下

natural: Able to speak and good at arguing

meaning.en: Eloquent and good at debate.
meaning.zh: 很会说话，善于辩论。

examples.zh: 他能言善辩，是学校辩论队的主力。
examples.en: He's eloquent and the star of the school debate team.

examples.zh: 律师都能言善辩。
examples.en: Lawyers are all silver-tongued.

natural: An old steed resting in its stable

meaning.en: Old but still ambitious.
meaning.zh: 比喻有志向的人虽然年老，仍有雄心壮志。

equivalents: still has fire in the belly

examples.zh: 爷爷老骥伏枥，退休后还在搞研究。
examples.en: Grandpa still has fire in his belly and does research in retirement.

examples.zh: 老骥伏枥，志在千里。
examples.en: The old steed in its stable still dreams of galloping a thousand li.

story.en: Cao Cao's poem, written in his fifties: "An old steed in the stable still longs to gallop a thousand li; a hero in his twilight years keeps his ambition" (老骥伏枥，志在千里；烈士暮年，壮心不已).
story.zh: 曹操《龟虽寿》："老骥伏枥，志在千里；烈士暮年，壮心不已。"

usage.en: Predicate. Usually with 志在千里. 骥 jì, 枥 lì.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"志在千里"连用。

natural: Trembling and cautious

meaning.en: Trembling with fear; extremely cautious.
meaning.zh: 形容因害怕而微微发抖的样子，也形容小心谨慎。

examples.zh: 他战战兢兢地走进校长办公室。
examples.en: He walked nervously into the headteacher's office.

examples.zh: 新员工做事战战兢兢，生怕出错。
examples.en: The new employee works gingerly, terrified of mistakes.

story.en: The Book of Songs: "Trembling and cautious, as if near a deep abyss, as if treading on thin ice" (战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰).
story.zh: 《诗经·小旻》："战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。"

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. An idiomatic AABB.

antonyms: 死猪不怕开水烫——满不在乎

natural: Old and doddering

meaning.en: Old and doddering; decrepit with age.
meaning.zh: 形容年老体衰，行动不灵便的样子。

examples.zh: 几年不见，他已经老态龙钟了。
examples.en: I hadn't seen him for a few years, and he's become quite doddery.

examples.zh: 一位老态龙钟的老人拄着拐杖慢慢走着。
examples.en: A decrepit old man walked slowly with a stick.

natural: The Arabian Nights

meaning.en: A fantastic tale; something absurd and impossible.
meaning.zh: 阿拉伯古代民间故事集《一千零一夜》的旧译名。比喻虚诞、离奇的议论。

examples.zh: 一个月学会一门外语？简直是天方夜谭。
examples.en: Learn a language in a month? That's pure fantasy.

examples.zh: 在古人看来，手机视频通话就是天方夜谭。
examples.en: To the ancients, video calls on a phone would have seemed like a fairy tale.

usage.en: Object, usually 简直是天方夜谭. Borrowed: 天方 (Arabia) + 夜谭 (night tales) was the early 20th-century Chinese title of The Arabian Nights.
usage.zh: 多作宾语。为《一千零一夜》的旧译名，二十世纪初出现。

natural: Lofty in bearing

meaning.en: Dignified and impressive in bearing.
meaning.zh: 形容人精力充沛，风度不凡。

examples.zh: 他身材高大，气宇轩昂。
examples.en: Tall and imposing, he has a commanding presence.

examples.zh: 仪仗队员个个气宇轩昂。
examples.en: Every member of the honour guard looked dignified and impressive.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. About men's bearing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多形容男子。
